source_method: Read existing local annual 20-F HTML/text files only; no downloads. XPath refers to lxml HTML parse of each named source. Exact short text locators and section/page locators supplied when preferred.

comparative_presentation_note: The two detected audited comparative changes are reconciled presentation changes. No explicit error-correction narrative for them was located. Do not call them error restatements.

findings.summary: USCXM was already controlled and consolidated. Agreement required repurchasing outside investors at original cost plus interest. NCI was recognized during the reporting period then derecognized against the repurchase liability at period end, with differences in equity. The April 2022 plan described 60%/20%/20% payments during 2022-2025; the later filing states completion all at once in July 2023. This is not a new consolidation-perimeter expansion.
